Resolves #19295

`GraphScene` draws a clustered scene through a foveated level of detail, in its own WebGL2 renderer with no external library.
- A scene may carry `clusters`, one cluster id per node.
- `setScene` derives the cluster centroids, one contiguous edge range per cluster, and one bundle line per connected cluster pair.
- The camera distance against the fitted distance picks the level:
  - **far** draws the bundles over the centroids.
  - **mid** draws the nodes and the bundles.
  - **near** adds the own edges of the `lod.nearClusters` clusters nearest the camera target.
- A level change only moves draw ranges; it uploads nothing.
- A scene without `clusters` draws as before.

The example gains a 100k-node, 1M-edge, 64-cluster scene ("100k clustered") and a timed lap over the levels ("LOD lap").

Evidence: L3 (unit arms red on dev first; the example's lap measured in headless branded Chrome on hardware GL, page visible) → L3 required (AC-6). Residual: none; the visible-window read on the operator's display is under Post-Merge Validation.

## Test Evidence

**AC-6, the LOD lap.**
- Witness: Chrome 154 (`channel: 'chrome'`, headless), ANGLE Metal on an Apple M5 Max, `visibilityState: visible`.
- Scene: a 1280×744 drawing buffer; 100k nodes, 1M edges, 64 clusters.
- Each level runs 5 s while the camera turns. Every frame gap counts as the level's time; `maxGapMs` is the level's longest gap. No run restarted a level (`restarts: 0`).
- At the fitted distance the scene is at far, drawing 2,016 bundle lines (64·63/2) in place of 1M edges.
- Measured at `f4d88c8169`, 2026-09-27, load average 4.9–6.5.

Presenting profile (`PRESENTING_LAUNCH_ARGS`, frame cap on): every level at 60.0–60.1 fps, longest gap 17–18 ms.

Engine profile (`ENGINE_LAUNCH_ARGS`, `--disable-frame-rate-limit`), fps (longest gap in ms):

| run | full | far | mid | near |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 243.4 (20) | 1801.8 (5) | 1316.5 (3) | 1203.6 (5) |
| 2 | 240.8 (20) | 1905.0 (5) | 1347.7 (3) | 1174.3 (4) |
| 3 | 215.8 (587) | 2375.4 (62) | 1235.6 (3) | 1163.3 (5) |
| median | 240.8 | 1905.0 | 1316.5 | 1174.3 |

- Run 3's full level held a 587 ms stall on the visible page. It counts in that run's rate; the lap before `f4d88c8169` dropped every gap of 250 ms or more, so this run would have reported the stall away.
- By the medians, far runs at 7.9× the full draw's rate, mid at 5.5× and near at 4.9×.

<details><summary>The lap script (scratch, not committed)</summary>

The script launches branded Chrome with `ENGINE_LAUNCH_ARGS` or `PRESENTING_LAUNCH_ARGS` from `test/playwright/e2e/utils/gpuIntent.mjs` and opens `examples/component/graphScene/index.html`. It then:
1. clicks "100k clustered" and polls "Read stats" until `counts.nodes === 100000`;
2. clicks "LOD lap" and polls "Read stats" until `lodLap.done`;
3. prints `lodLap.results` (`{fps, frames, maxGapMs, ms}` by level), `lodLap.restarts` and the `canvas` size of the final read.
</details>

## Post-Merge Validation

### `@neo-opus-ada` commented on 2026-09-27T08:38:27Z

**Addressed** — [review 5329507667](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19302#pullrequestreview-5329507667), now at `f4d88c8169`.

**RA-1, the focal set follows the camera target.** `getLodPlan` passes `camera.target` to `nearestClusters`. `eyePosition` had no other caller and is gone. Two arms cover it:
- The positive arm now places the target on cluster 9.
- New control: "an orbit around an unmoved target keeps the near clusters, wherever the eye passes". The target sits on cluster 3, and the eye moves from beside cluster 9 (+x) to beside cluster 7 (−x). It is red at `98b3cbbedd` and green now.

The ticket's wording (target) stands, so no contract change.

**RA-2, the lap counts every gap.**
- The example's `Renderer.stepLap` counts every frame gap as the level's time. Each level now reports `{fps, frames, maxGapMs, ms}`.
- A `pause` starts the interrupted level over and counts it in `lodLap.restarts`, so hidden time never enters a result and never disappears silently.
- The controlled falsifier, `Renderer.spec` "a stall counts as the level's time and shows as its longest gap", injects a 300 ms stall and expects `{fps: 27.6, frames: 14, maxGapMs: 300, ms: 508}`. With the old `< 250` exclusion put back into `stepLap`, it goes red. Two more arms cover the level order and the pause restart.
- AC-6 was re-measured at `f4d88c8169`; the table is in the body. Engine medians: full 240.8, far 1905.0, mid 1316.5, near 1174.3 fps. Presenting holds 60 fps at every level, with a longest gap of 17–18 ms.
- Run 3 shows why the instrument matters: its full level had a 587 ms stall on the visible page. That stall now lowers its rate (215.8) and shows as its `maxGapMs`. The old lap would have dropped it.

Unit: `GraphScene.spec` + `Renderer.spec`, 24 passed.
